description_en: Queries the compliance statistics for rules in a specified compliance package
description_zh: 查询指定合规包中规则维度合规统计
name: GetConfigRuleComplianceByPack

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the compliance package.

For more information about how to obtain the compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/263332.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_id

ConfigRuleComplianceResult.description_en: The compliance results for the rules in the compliance package
ConfigRuleComplianceResult.description_zh: 合规包中规则的合规结果

CompliancePackId.description_en: The ID of the compliance package

CompliantCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果全部为合规的规则总数

ConfigRuleCompliances.description_en: The list of rules in the compliance package and their compliance results
ConfigRuleCompliances.description_zh: 合规包中的规则及合规结果列表

ComplianceType.description_en:
The compliance evaluation result of the rule. Valid values:

COMPLIANT: The rule is compliant.

NON_COMPLIANT: The rule is non-compliant.

NOT_APPLICABLE: The rule is not applicable.

INSUFFICIENT_DATA: No data is available
ComplianceType.description_zh:
规则合规评估结果。取值：
COMPLIANT：合规。
NON_COMPLIANT：不合规。
NOT_APPLICABLE：不适用。
INSUFFICIENT_DATA：无数据

ConfigRuleId.description_en: The ID of the rule in the compliance package

ConfigRuleName.description_en: The name of the rule in the compliance package
ConfigRuleName.example: The bandwidth of the Elastic IP instance meets the minimum requirements.

IgnoredCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果包含“已忽略”的规则总数

InsufficientDataCount.description_en: The total number of rules within the compliance package whose evaluation results are "No Data" when assessing resources
InsufficientDataCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果包含“无数据”的规则总数

NotApplicableCount.description_en: The number of rules that are not applicable
NotApplicableCount.description_zh: 合规包内的规则进行评估资源时，评估结果包含“不适用”的规则总数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of rules in the compliance package
